p: Authenticate with a bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <your key> . Keys are created and revoked in the console , and revoking one there is what stops it working.

a: console

p: Every route lives under /v1 , and every service answers on the same host — there is no second base URL to configure and no v2 waiting to break the first one. Rate limits are applied per caller and across the edge as a whole; a rejected request comes back as a 429 with a Retry-After rather than a dropped connection.
A few of the ones people reach for first. Every parameter and error shape is in the reference.

a: /v1/chat/completions POST A completion from any model your organization can reach, streamed or buffered. Model ids come from the catalog, so the list is a request rather than a page in the docs.
/v1/responses POST Stateful multi-turn responses with built-in tool calling, structured outputs, reasoning traces, and server-managed conversation state.
/v1/decisions POST Sub-10ms structured classification, routing, scoring, and guardrail decisions powered by Kai at a fraction of LLM cost.
/v1/videos/generations POST Generate cinematic video with synchronized audio and camera motion from text or reference frames via Koma.
/v1/images/generations POST Photorealistic image generation, inpainting, and layout-accurate typography rendering via Iro.
/v1/audio/speech · /v1/audio/music POST Low-latency neural speech synthesis, voice cloning, transcription, foley sound effects, and full-track music generation via Koe, Oto, and Uta.
/v1/3d/generations POST Textured 3D meshes and spatial world assets generated from text prompts or multi-view images via Mori.
/v1/embeddings POST Vectors for search, retrieval and clustering, from the same key and the same bill as generation.
/v1/models GET What your organization may call right now — every model we serve plus any provider account you have connected, with their identifiers and pricing.
/v1/agents GET · POST Define an agent once, run it by reference, and read its runs afterwards. The definition lives here, so everything that runs it runs the same one.
/v1/code/search · /v1/code/ask GET · POST AST-indexed symbol search, repository context assembly, and semantic codebase Q&A across your organization’s repositories.
/v1/sandbox POST Lease isolated microVM sandboxes with filesystem, terminal WebSocket, headless browser screen streaming, and sub-second startup.
/v1/crawl · /v1/search POST Clean markdown extraction from any live web page and structured real-time web search for RAG and agent research.

/v1/billing/balance · /v1/billing/usage GET What is left, and what was spent. Usage is recorded per call and attributed to the organization on the token, so a bill can be traced back to the request that caused it.
/v1/tools GET The tools your organization can call over REST or MCP. An agent picks from this list, and so can you — it is the same catalog either way.
